insert_sql:
INSERT INTO INSURANCE_REGULATORY.SILVER.FHCF_EXPOSURE_STAGING (
  insurer_naic, policy_number, risk_zip, risk_zip4, county_fips, state_code, policy_form, effective_date, expiry_date, occupancy_type, construction_type, year_built, protection_class, coverage_a, hurricane_deductible, written_premium, wind_mitigation, opening_protection, roof_cover_type, roof_deck_attachment, roof_to_wall_connection, secondary_water_resistance, latitude, longitude, reporting_year, source_file
)
SELECT
  (SELECT LPAD(TRIM(MAX(uw.naiccode)), 10, '0') FROM INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_UWCOMPANY uw) AS insurer_naic,
  TRIM(p.policynumber) AS policy_number,
  LPAD(TRIM(CAST(dw.zip AS STRING)), 5, '0') AS risk_zip,
  CASE WHEN dw.ziplus4 IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(dw.ziplus4 AS STRING)) = '' THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(TRIM(CAST(dw.ziplus4 AS STRING)), 4, '0') END AS risk_zip4,
  TRIM(dw.countyfips) AS county_fips,
  UPPER(TRIM(dw.state)) AS state_code,
  TRIM(line.holineform) AS policy_form,
  CAST(line.effectivedate AS DATE) AS effective_date,
  CAST(line.expirationdate AS DATE) AS expiry_date,
  CASE WHEN line.occupancytype = 'OwnerOccupied' THEN 'O1' ELSE 'O2' END AS occupancy_type,
  TRIM(CAST(dw.constructiontype AS STRING)) AS construction_type,
  CAST(dw.yearbuilt AS INT) AS year_built,
  CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(dw.ppccode AS STRING)), '') AS INT) AS protection_class,
  CAST(cov.coverageamount AS BIGINT) AS coverage_a,
  CAST(cov.tropicalcyclonedeductible AS INT) AS hurricane_deductible,
  CAST(ROUND(cov.writtenpremium) AS BIGINT) AS written_premium,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS wind_mitigation,
  dw.openingprotection AS opening_protection,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(line.roofcoveringtype) ELSE NULL END AS roof_cover_type,
  dw.roofdeckattachment AS roof_deck_attachment,
  dw.rooftowallconnection AS roof_to_wall_connection,
  dw.secondarywaterresistance AS secondary_water_resistance,
  CAST(dw.latitude AS BIGINT) AS latitude,
  CAST(dw.longitude AS BIGINT) AS longitude,
  2025 AS reporting_year,
  'FHCF_D1A_GUIDEWIRE_2025.txt' AS source_file
FROM INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_POLICY p
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HOPOLICYLINE line ON line.policy_id = p.id
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HOCOVERAGE cov ON cov.policyline_id = line.id
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HODWELLING dw ON dw.policyline_id = line.id
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(dw.state)) = 'FL'

provenance.review_summary: 26 proposed · 7 overridden in review · rest accepted as proposed. Compiled output verified row-identical to the hand-written FHCF_SILVER_SQL reference (tests/test_fhcf_mapping_compile.py).

overrides.reason: OVERRIDE: proposal took RIGHT(...,2) assuming a full 5-digit FIPS; Bronze already carries the 2-digit FL county sub-code, so plain TRIM is correct.

overrides.proposed: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(line.occupancytype)) IN ('OWNEROCCUPIED','OWNER_OCCUPIED') AND CAST(dw.numberoffamilies AS INT) = 1 THEN 'O1' ELSE 'O2' END
overrides.accepted_as: CASE WHEN line.occupancytype = 'OwnerOccupied' THEN 'O1' ELSE 'O2' END
overrides.reason: OVERRIDE: dropped the proposal's extra numberoffamilies=1 clause — the implemented FHCF encoding keys on occupancy only (HO book is single-family; a NULL family count must not demote O1 to O2).
OVERRIDE: BIGINT → INT to match the target DDL (values are whole-dollar deductibles).

overrides.proposed: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(dw.openingprotection) ELSE NULL END
overrides.reason: OVERRIDE: Direct from the OIR-B1-1802 extension column — the carrier only populates companions when an inspection is on file, so the proposal's CASE gate is redundant.

overrides.proposed: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(dw.roofdeckattachment) ELSE NULL END
overrides.reason: OVERRIDE: Direct from the extension column (see opening_protection).

overrides.reason: OVERRIDE: Direct from the extension column (see opening_protection).

overrides.proposed: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.secondarywaterresistance)) ELSE NULL END
